name: Judgment and Redemption
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Take this satchel - in it are the items you will need for your task.

Use the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to bring forth accursed spirits that must be judged.  Use your judgments wisely during this trial - they will prove more potent than you realize.  After the spirits, the death knight will appear; defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the charger.  Only then adventurer, will you be able to redeem it and place your barding upon your new steed!

Good luck!
narrative.objectives:
Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance.  Doing so will bring forth the spirits you must judge.  Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver.  Defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the fallen charger.

Give the Charger's Redeemed Soul and the Blessed Enchanted Barding to Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.
narrative.offerRewardText:
A glimmer of life - long vacant from the poor beast - shines in its eyes as you hand its judged soul back to it. You feel a holy rush of power surge around you as you place the barding on its back, having judged the charger redeemed. The charger nuzzles your hand as the burdens of the past are lifted from the beast. You now feel as though you could call upon this beast to serve as your steed, should the need arise.

You have claimed your epic charger, Champion! Congratulations!
narrative.requestItemsText: The spirit of the fallen charger looks upon you with a mournful gaze. Sad, almost hollow eyes look at you as though all hope was lost to it.

chain.subtitle: 11 quests at level 60, 37,350 XP in all.

quests.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

quests.name: Emphasis on Sacrifice
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Ironforge and get High Priest Rohan's Exorcism Censer.

quests.name: To Show Due Judgment
quests.objectiveText: Return the Exorcism Censer to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Exorcising Terrordale
quests.objectiveText: Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the spirits that torment Terrordale.

quests.name: The Work of Grimand Elmore
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Grimand Elmore in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

quests.name: Collection of Goods
quests.objectiveText: Bring 40 Runecloth, 6 Arcanite Bars, 10 Arthas' Tears, 5 Stratholme Holy Water vials, and 150 gold to Grimand Elmore in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Ancient Equine Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse.

quests.name: Blessed Arcanite Barding
quests.objectiveText: Return with the Blessed Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

quests.name: The Divination Scryer
quests.objectiveText: Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Judgment and Redemption
quests.objectiveText: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance.
